entities.name: UniProt O89341
observations: Exact sequence match to the 352-aa Hendra virus matrix protein; 100% identity and coverage.
Matrix protein forms a shell at the inner face of infected-cell plasma membrane and plays a role in virion assembly and budding; annotation describes this as by similarity.
Annotated locations include virion, host cytoplasm, host nucleus, and inner plasma-membrane face during budding.
Pfam matches: Matrix_Paramyxo_N (PF00661; residues 18–184) and Matrix_Paramyxo_C (PF23765; residues 187–345).
Protein is annotated as a homomultimer and structural constituent of virion; no catalytic reaction or cofactor annotation was retrieved.

entities.name: Paramyxovirus virion assembly
observations: Hendra virus matrix protein O89341 is annotated for virion assembly and budding (GO:0019068).

entities.name: Infected host cell
observations: Hendra virus matrix protein O89341 is annotated in host-cell cytoplasm and nucleus and associates with the inner face of the plasma membrane during budding.
